description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control, triggering Birgi and Kykar.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
